newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-SCIFO OUT FOR BELGIUM-NETHERLANDS QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCIFO OUT FOR BELGIUM-NETHERLANDS QUALIFIER.

text.p: Belgium captain Enzo Scifo said on Thursday he would miss next week's crucial World Cup qualifier against the Netherlands because of a toe injury.
The Monaco midfielder, who was set to return to competition after fracturing a toe two months ago, told the Het Laatste Nieuws newspaper the toe had become badly infected on Wednesday.

"I'll miss Belgium-Netherlands and that hurts me a lot. For two months that match was my main goal," Scifo said. "For me the participation in a fourth World Cup is at stake, that's why I'm so terribly disappointed."
Group seven leaders the Netherlands, who routed Wales 7-1 in their previous qualifier last month, and Belgium are both still unbeaten after two qualifiers each.
Belgium beat the Dutch 1-0 in their previous encounter in the first round of the 1994 World Cup.
Emotions traditionally run high for matches when the two neighbouring countries meet for soccer matches which are dubbed "duels of the Low Lands".
